title: Scientific Programming
description: Programming for scientific problems in MATLAB and Python: script files and variables, arrays, vectors and matrices, plotting and anonymous functions, Python basics and control flow, and Python functions with NumPy. The course folder holds only its tests (two MATLAB practical tests and a 2024/25 Python test), so the title is inferred from them and every topic is written from general knowledge of such a course.

topics.title: The MATLAB Environment, Variables and Script Files
topics.summary: MATLAB is an interactive environment for numerical computing built around matrices. Commands run in the Command Window or are saved in script files (.m), using variables, arithmetic operators and built-in functions.
subtopics: The Command Window, workspace and current folder

topics.title: Arrays, Vectors and Matrices in MATLAB
topics.summary: MATLAB stores data in arrays: row and column vectors and matrices. Elements and whole rows or columns are picked out by indexing, and matrix operations include products, transposes and the dot and cross products of vectors.
subtopics: Ranges with the colon operator and linspace

topics.title: Plotting and Anonymous Functions
topics.summary: MATLAB draws 2-D graphs with plot, labelled with titles, axis labels, grids and legends, including parametric curves. Anonymous functions define one-line functions with the @ operator, and user-defined function files return outputs.
subtopics: The plot command and line styles
Multiple plots: hold on and subplot

topics.title: Python Basics and Control Flow
topics.summary: Python is a high-level, interpreted, dynamically typed language. Programs use variables, data types, input and output, and control flow with if/elif/else and for and while loops to make decisions and repeat work.
subtopics: Python as an interpreted, dynamically typed language

topics.title: Python Functions and NumPy
topics.summary: Functions package reusable code with parameters and return values. NumPy provides fast n-dimensional arrays for numerical work, with element-wise arithmetic and functions such as mean along rows or columns.
subtopics: Means and sums along an axis
